sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1 languoid records katl1237 (Katla) and julu1237 (Julud), and reference records 24688, 325512, 588880, 575578, 588881.
sources.note: katl1237 MED = Meinhof 1916-17 only; julu1237 MEDs = Nüsslein 2020 (grammar_sketch), Nüsslein 2019 (Erfurt PhD), Nüsslein 2018 'Number marking in Julut' (NMLS New Insights 281-295), Knoblecher 1849. Glottolog note: Julud mutually intelligible with Katla-Kulharong but not with Katla-Cakom (p.c. Hellwig 2007).

sources.note: Phonology section (consonants, 7 vowel qualities) sourced to Nüsslein 2020 pp. 30-31; nothing on stress or tone. Bibliography lists Tucker & Bryan 1966 'The Katla Group', Nüsslein 2020, Meinhof 1917.
